facts.behavior: UN:G1 takes original creature0..196 and field0..2: singular, plural or description.
Binding stores a z-string index,1..1000; zero restores the original name. The binding references live string storage.
MA:U applies a four-byte operand to the original upgrade table.
MA:X applies a four-byte operand to creature flags then invalidates the original creature cache.

admittedCases: UN:G1 creature text fields, with query/write/relative binding operands
limits: Other upgrade-table writes and arbitrary creature flag arithmetic remain unadmitted. Flight granted by other bonuses is preserved. Shared creature definitions are not changed.
sourceUse: Unchanged zc3-0 Vampire names, upgrade-disable and flight-disable initializers.
saveContract: Map-local JSON and existing bonus serialization; native save version906 remains unchanged.
